comment: Resorts of the SnowBuddy ski map data, one per published ski file (written by scripts/export-public-data.mjs in the SnowBuddy repository). Boxes are W, S, E, N in degrees (WGS84): the resort's lifts and runs with at least 2 km to spare on every side, and the out-of-bounds runs in out_of_bounds_named whole at every zoom. osm_timestamp is the OpenStreetMap data the file was built from; pipeline/build-ski.sh rebuilds from it and compares the result with ski_file.sha256.
